title: Protocol to isolate and enrich mouse splenic naive CD4+ T cells for in vitro CD4+CD8αα+ cell induction
protocol: Euthanize C57BL/6J mice by cervical dislocation.
Disinfect the surgical area with 70% ethanol to prevent contamination.
Cut open the abdomen and expose the spleen in the abdominal cavity.
Place the spleen in a petri dish containing 5 mL of HBSS solution.
Place the spleen on a 100 μm cell strainer.
Crush the spleen with a syringe plunger.
Place LS column in the magnetic field and rinse the column with 3 mL of MACS buffer.
Collect flow-through containing unlabeled cells.
Collect the spleen and place it in a petri dish containing 5 mL of HBSS on ice.
Place a 100 μm cell strainer on top of a 50 mL conical tube.
Place the spleen on the cell strainer and crush with a syringe plunger.
Add ice-cold HBSS several times to rinse off cells.
Adjust the volume to 30 mL for each tube with ice-cold HBSS solution.
Centrifuge (600 × g, 5 min, at 4°C).
Discard supernatant.
Add 2 ml of 0.84% ammonium chloride on cell pellet and resuspend by pipetting.
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Add 20 ml of ice-cold HBSS solution and centrifuge (600 × g, 5 min, at 4°C).
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet with 10 ml of HBSS solution.
Count cell number and transfer 5 × 10^7 cells into new 15 mL conical tube.
Fill up volume to 10 ml with ice-cold MACS buffer and centrifuge (600 × g, 5 min, at 4°C).
Resuspend cell pellet in 200 μl of ice-cold MACS buffer.
Add 50 μl of Biotin-Antibody Cocktail and mix well.
Incubate for 5 min in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Add 100 μL of MACS buffer, 100 μL of Anti-Biotin Microbeads, and 50 μL of CD44 Microbeads to the cell suspension.
Mix well and incubate for 10 min in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Add 5 mL of ice-cold MACS buffer to the cell suspension and centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Place LS column in the MidiMACS separator and rinse with 3 ml of MACS buffer.
Resuspend cell pellet with 1 ml of MACS buffer and apply onto the column.
Collect flow-through containing unlabeled cells, representing enriched naive CD4+ T cells.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 10 ml of T cell culture medium and centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet with 1 ml of T cell medium.
Take 50 μL of aliquot for quality control.
Wash cells with 200 μL of FACS buffer and centrifuge (800 × g, 3 min, at 4°C).
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 50 μL of Fc blocker solution.
Incubate cells for 10 min at 4°C.
Add antibody cocktail to the cells.
Incubate cells for 30 min in the dark at 4°C.
Fill up volume to 200 μL with FACS buffer and centrifuge (800 × g, 3 min, at 4°C).
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet with 400 μL of FACS buffer.
Analyze cells on a flow cytometer.
Wash pre-coated 96-well flat-bottom plate 3 times with DPBS.
Remove coating solution with a suction.
Add 100 μL of DPBS to each well using multichannel pipette.
Remove DPBS with a suction.
Repeat adding and removing DPBS two more times.
In the end, add 100 μL DPBS to keep the pre-coated bottom wet.
Remove DPBS from washed 96-well plate right before use.
Add 50 μL of enriched naive CD4+ T cell suspension (1 × 10^5 cells) per well onto pre-coated 96-well plate.
Add 50 μL of anti-CD28 solution (final concentration: 1 μg/mL diluted with culture medium) to each well.
Add 50 μL of mixed cytokine solution to each well.
Add 50 μL of T cell culture medium to fill up the volume to 200 μL.
Place the cells into a 5% CO₂ incubator at 37°C for 4 days.
For hypoxic conditions, use medium stored under hypoxic conditions to prepare enriched cells, anti-CD28 solution, and mixed cytokine solution.
Put the cells in an airtight container with a new Anaeropack and close immediately.
Place the airtight container into an incubator at 37°C for 4 days.
Harvest all cells (per well) 4 days after initiating culture.
Transfer cells into a new 96-well U-bottom plate and centrifuge at 800 × g, 3 min, at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 50 μL of Fc blocker solution.
Incubate cells for 10 min at 4°C.
Add antibody cocktail to the cells.
Incubate cells for 30 min in the dark at 4°C.
Fill up volume to 200 μL with FACS buffer and centrifuge (800 × g, 3 min, at 4°C).
Discard supernatant and resuspend the cells in 100 μL of fixation buffer.
Incubate cells for 30 min in the dark at 4°C.
Centrifuge the cells (800 × g, 3 min, at 4°C).
Discard supernatant and resuspend the cells in 200 μL of permeabilization buffer.
Centrifuge the cells (800 × g, 3 min, at 4°C).
Discard supernatant and resuspend the cells in 50 μL of anti-Foxp3 solution diluted with permeabilization buffer.
Incubate cells for 1 h in the dark at 4°C.
Centrifuge the cells (800 × g, 3 min, at 4°C).
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Transfer cells into 5 mL tubes.
Fill up volume to 400 μL with FACS buffer.
Acquire cells on a flow cytometer.
Analyze data using FlowJo software.
